label: Connectivity by union-find
subgoals: Union same-layer shapes that overlap or touch
Union the two shapes joined by each via
Count the remaining disjoint sets as nets

label: Labels, shorts and net names
subgoals: Extract the nets before reading labels
Collect the distinct label names on each net
Report nets with more than one distinct name as shorts

label: Critical vias and opens
subgoals: Count the nets with every via present
Remove one via at a time and recount
Count the vias whose removal increases the net count
